releases.notes: Behind-the-scenes improvements to catalog loading and downloads.
Much faster, steadier downloads for large apps: the store now fetches in parallel pieces, drops slow connections and retries, and survives expired download links. Interrupted downloads resume.

Much faster, steadier downloads for large apps: the store now fetches in parallel pieces, drops slow connections and retries, and survives expired download links. Interrupted downloads resume.
Installs apps signed with Panda Gallery's own key too. Everything else unchanged.
Only installs apps signed with your own keys. Shows download speed and time left. Pause auto-update for any app, see older release notes, and the app is 6× smaller.
New Share button on each app's page: send the APK to friends via WhatsApp, Telegram, Gmail and more.
Foreground service for active installs to prevent background throttling, resumable HTTP Range downloads, and fixes for background update installation and self-update.

releases.notes: Interactive price history chart: tap to inspect price, date, and store for every point. Eliminated random store-switching lines, added price direction badge (up/down delta), and full price history bottom sheet on wishlist.
Hunt screen now shows when each store was last checked, in-stock watches float to the top with a green outline, and price is always tracked since you added the watch to your hunt list.

history.notes: Interactive price history chart: tap to inspect price, date, and store for every point. Eliminated random store-switching lines, added price direction badge (up/down delta), and full price history bottom sheet on wishlist.
Hunt screen now shows when each store was last checked, in-stock watches float to the top with a green outline, and price is always tracked since you added the watch to your hunt list.
Fixed price display on out-of-stock watches by ignoring EMI fees and preserving last recorded in-stock or Bhawar authorized reference prices. Added in-app startup update checks from Panda App Store.

Added Stock History & Hot Sellers tracking: view a live chronological feed of watches restocked and sold out on each price refresh, see stock velocity metrics (duration in stock), discover hot sellers, and jump straight to watch details to buy when in stock.

Smarter model-number matching across stores, so short models like F-91W and GA-2100 are found more reliably. 'Limited stock' now counts as available for Buy and cheapest-price. Clearer alerts when a watch hits your target price, plus visual polish.

releases.notes: Checks for updates when the app opens (turn it off in Settings, About). Batch progress shows real counts. Smart Optimize uses the preset you pick. Originals are kept if the Safety Vault backup fails. Compression fixes for portrait videos, HDR, AVIF metadata and Target Size.

releases.notes:
Stock is matched against your collection in the background once a day, after the shops are read, so the Stock tab opens faster.
Cars on your hunt list no longer appear on the Collection screen; they stay on the Hunt tab.
The Rare & Exclusives Vault banner moved to the bottom of Find a car.
Progress bars now show while cases, shops, photos and card lookups are working.
Fixed collection header layout so the number of castings and total cars is always clearly visible and never covered or clipped by action buttons.

history.notes:
Stock is matched against your collection in the background once a day, after the shops are read, so the Stock tab opens faster.
Cars on your hunt list no longer appear on the Collection screen; they stay on the Hunt tab.
The Rare & Exclusives Vault banner moved to the bottom of Find a car.
Progress bars now show while cases, shops, photos and card lookups are working.
Fixed collection header layout so the number of castings and total cars is always clearly visible and never covered or clipped by action buttons.
Background stock checks now wake the app less often, so Android's battery manager no longer flags Panda Garage as misbehaving. Scheduled checks may run up to about 30 minutes after their set time.
Fixed the shutter spinning after you close the scanner and reopen it. Card scanning and matching are unchanged.
Adding a car now always starts with the Card photo as the collection thumbnail (star on by default), even when photos are fetched or added.
Sharing a photo to Panda Garage now asks what to do: search in the store (stores and prices) or search my garage to see if I already have it. Nothing is added automatically.

Sharing a photo to Panda Garage from WhatsApp or your gallery now identifies the car and searches the shops for it, with stores and prices, instead of opening the add flow. Adding cars is still done inside the app.
Stock now refreshes automatically once a day — the first time you open the app, or the first time you get a connection that day. Respects Wi-Fi only.
The collection thumbnail star now turns on automatically for the photo you add (e.g. a card photo when there is no model photo), so you no longer have to enable it each time.
Fixed the app crashing when opening a car, and fixed saves failing when phone storage for app data filled up. The optional Diagnostic log in Profile is still there if you need it.
Added an optional Diagnostic log in Profile (off by default) with Copy and Share buttons, and made saving cars safer so edits are no longer lost or stalled.

Upgrades Settings and filter sheets to Cyber Glass with fluid tactile controls. Fixes multi-column metric text wrapping and header title truncation across mobile viewports. Improves collection storage reliability with atomic serialized native backups.
Sets the Model photo as the default collection thumbnail across the app, keeping it pre-selected when adding a car even before a photo is uploaded. Defaults detail view to the model photo tab.
Sets the Card photo as the default collection thumbnail when adding a model, keeping the star option enabled even before a photo is uploaded. Defaults detail view to the card photo tab.

Adds a 'Buy Again' option in your collection and car details to put favorite castings back on your hunt list. Adds direct 'Add to List' actions and shows a Buy Again badge on the hunt screen and store scanner.
Defaults collection thumbnails and detail view to the card photo with the starred display option enabled. Adds a duplicates filter in the collection to view cars with multiple copies.
Adds inline name editing and quick candidate chips to scan results. Fixes scanner scrolling to bottom buttons when cars are listed. Mandates 30-second progress monitoring for builds.

Allows editing misread car names directly on scan results with alternative text candidates and instant re-search. Fixes scrolling to bottom buttons when car matches are listed. Adds a setting to mute shutter sound and use haptic vibration.
Adds an option in settings and the scanner to mute the camera shutter sound and use vibration haptic feedback instead when taking photos.
FirstCry is now in the Stock tab, read for your pincode. Hunt also looks up every car on your list on FirstCry by name, so one that is in stock there shows up.

releases.notes: Friends edition is now the main app without the Stock tab. Hunt, Orders, Cases and stock alerts are included, as in the main app. The Garage and For owner tabs are gone.
App update checking and Hobby Estate shop added. Checks for newer builds at startup and offers to install through Panda App Store.

Fixes: a car with a named livery (Gulf, Martini, HKS...) that the owner already has is now shown as owned, not a different colour. Treasure Hunt wording no longer hides an owned car. Scanning a barcode with no name now says to search by name instead of giving the all-clear. An order already on the way is no longer shown as a different colour.
